summary: Verified all 4 changes end-to-end: (1) Master-admin org list returns owner_email with fallback and iso-demo-org resolves owner@isodemo.com. (2) Pulse operator dashboard Faults sub-tabs order = Reactive → Request a Part → Planned Maintenance (data-testids faults-view-reactive/faults-view-request-part/faults-view-ppm). (3) Lite operator dashboard order identical (lite-faults-view-*). (4) CRM Company detail top tabs consolidated exactly as spec — Overview, Contacts, Deals, Service & Engineers, Activity, Equipment & Assets, Quotes, Tenders, Site Surveys, Invoices; every merged parent's inner sub-nav (equipment_assets, site_surveys, service_hub, activity) renders and every child (sites_equipment/equipment/assets, surveys/drawings, cases/service, activities/timeline/audit) is clickable and renders content without console crashes. All old standalone top-level tabs (assets, equipment, sites_equipment, drawings, cases, timeline, audit) are gone.
critical_code_review_comments: PARENT_SUBTABS.service_hub renders only 1 child (cases) when has_service_ops=false, and the innerTabs.length>1 gate hides the subnav in that case — this is intentional per spec but worth noting: users of non-service orgs will see the parent tab jump straight to 'cases' with no subnav (acceptable).
